integrity: All newly reported computations are derived from the graph specification by the included complete, reproducible integer and mod-2 checkers. The reported review is not an independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Fixed labeled Pappus graph and ordinary matching complex only; the sphere-wedge homotopy type and rank-40 integral homology were already known. Complete 297-case finite enumeration and exact integral certificates prove new carrier statements but do not establish a general formula for cubic graphs or bibliographic priority.
title: Shortest octahedral homology carriers of the Pappus matching complex
